environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. Service runs as systemd unit with CAP_KILL granted to the application user. Nginx reverse proxy in front passes all traffic without modification. No response header injection. Operators use SIGUSR2 to enable debug diagnostics during incidents. An attacker who can send SIGUSR2 (local user, or via exposed management API) can race the signal to enable debug mode during a request containing XSS payload in the 'q' parameter.

config.reverse_proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass only, no header additions
config.process_capabilities: CAP_KILL available to app user group
